svg.title: O3R335 clearance area — rear three-quarter view
svg.desc: A rear three-quarter view of a dark camera housing with a translucent red clearance volume. The optical face points away and is hidden. The spatial panel is schematic, not to scale, and not a validated three-dimensional mounting envelope. Separate top and side insets show 24 degrees and 36 degrees on each side, measured from the outward extension of the camera front-face plane, and a 300 mm perpendicular reference distance. The red region is clearance, not optical field of view. Use the dimensioned top and side views for mounting decisions.
svg.text: Keep the space in front of the camera free of obstructions.
Optical face points into the clearance area
